name: Landing: aircraft on the ground are shown, not alerted on
description: Ownship flies a final approach to a runway at 5,400 ft and lands. One aircraft is holding short beside the touchdown point, one is taxiing and one is parked: all three are drawn as on the ground and never raise an advisory. Pattern traffic and a departure are airborne and far enough away to stay quiet. Once ownship touches down it is on the ground too. Expected: no advisories. Without the ground flags the same approach gives a traffic advisory and a climb RA on short final.
